summary: Iteration 26 — Trade Block system (backend POST/GET/DELETE/PUT/summary/refresh + frontend LeagueDetailPage card + Lovable Team page TradeBlockManager). Backend: 15/15 pass + 1 skipped (pick test - no draft-picks API endpoint discoverable for test fixture; pick path covered by manual curl). Regression: test_crown_flow.py and test_trade_flow.py both PASS. Frontend smoke (chriszarek@gmail.com on Ice Kings): LeagueDetailPage shows 6 top-trade-block items with retention badges + FPTS/PPG tiles + 'View all 6 →' link. Lovable Team page mounts TradeBlockManager with all 7 required testIDs (team-trade-block-manager, 3× team-retention-*, trade-block-pick-select, trade-block-commit-pick, 21× trade-block-toggle-{player_id}). Retention toggle persists via PUT and emits success toast 'Salary retention: A · Willing to retain'. Other-team /teams/{id} route does NOT mount TradeBlockManager — needs main-agent confirmation if read-only mode was supposed to be on a different route.

minor.issue: Returns legacy items (added before iter26) without team_name / salary_retention_pref because they were created without team_id. The endpoint does NOT backfill these fields on read. Frontend will see undefined for retention badge on legacy rows. Suggest either (a) one-time migration to populate team_name from owner_id, or (b) fallback in summary handler.

integration_issues.issue: Problem statement says route is /team but actual App.js mounts LovableTeam at /roster (App.js L91). /team returns 404. Either docs in problem statement are stale OR a route alias should be added.

integration_issues.flow: Roster quick-toggle add to trade block
integration_issues.issue: Clicking trade-block-toggle-{player_id} chip did NOT visibly add an item card under 'Trade Block' (items count stayed 0 after click + 2.5s wait, UI still showed 'Nothing on the block yet.'). Backend POST /trade-block works fine (verified in pytest), so this is likely a frontend issue: either the togglePlayer call's POST fails silently, or the items list isn't re-fetched after the optimistic toggle. Note: the retention toggle (PUT) DOES work and emits toast.

TradeBlockManager does NOT render on /teams/{id} for OTHER teams. Per spec it should render read-only. Either the read-only branch was scoped only to /roster (which only ever shows OWN team via active league context), or the integration was missed on /teams/{id}.

action_items: Investigate frontend togglePlayer POST flow on Lovable Team page — chip click is not surfacing the new trade-block item in the UI (no error toast visible either; possibly silent failure of the optimistic re-fetch).
Decide on /team vs /roster route — either alias /team → /roster or update spec/docs.
Confirm whether read-only TradeBlockManager should also mount on /teams/{id} (other team's profile). Currently it only renders on /roster (own team).
Optional backend fix: backfill team_name + salary_retention_pref in trade-block-summary handler so legacy items render the retention badge.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L3055-3153 add_to_trade_block: enrichment is correct. season_stats fallback to player root fields is defensive. recent_form_ppw computed from week_summaries last-3 sorted by week desc — note this uses team_id+league_id of the OWNER, not the player's team, which is the correct semantic (we want the team's recent form as a proxy for value).
server.py L3155-3171 GET /trade-block: added league_id/team_id/owner_id filters. Good. Sort by created_at desc.
server.py L3193-3211 PUT /teams/{id}/trade-block-preference: validates value, owner-only via owner_id check, AND cascades via update_many. Idempotent and atomic per team. Good.

server.py L3214-3230 trade-block-summary: in-memory sort by (fantasy_points, recent_form_ppw) desc. Limit clamped to [1,50]. CAVEAT: legacy items with no team_id are included in the list and missing team_name + salary_retention_pref. UI will show 'undefined' badge unless guarded.
server.py L3233-3281 refresh-stats: commissioner OR co-commissioner allowed (good — not just commissioner). Re-pulls season_stats + recent_form. Idempotent. Returns items_refreshed count.

TradeBlockManager.tsx: testIDs all match spec. Uses /trade-block?team_id={id} for fetch. Uses /teams/{id}/trade-block-preference for retention update. Read-only branch likely guarded by isOwnTeam prop — verify which page passes isOwnTeam=false.
App.js L91: route is /roster (not /team). Spec mismatch.
